freeze_rule: This protocol and its outputs are frozen after execution. Any material change requires a new protocol_id.

instrumentation.postgresql_txid: simulated (no live DB in perturbation replay)

objective: Root-cause replay and formal reconciliation of TOCTOU-V2-05 and TOCTOU-V2-09 historical classification mismatches from GLHS-POSTGRES-TOCTOU-FINAL-V2-20260817-01
reconciliation_policy: DO NOT modify historical artifacts. Produce new explanatory artifacts in the E05 protocol directory.

replay_design.timing_model: controlled jitter on governance_delay_us and proposal/commit_delay_us

roles.architecture: Trace execution paths for V2-05 and V2-09; identify whether mismatches result from oracle error, conservative rejection, lock ordering, timestamp insufficiency, implementation behavior, or protocol ambiguity
roles.implementation: Create evaluation/glhs_toctou_root_cause/ with replay scripts and analysis; execute 100 perturbations per schedule
roles.red_team: Verify root-cause classification is honest; ensure no historical artifact rewriting occurs; confirm safety invariant holds in all conditions
roles.reproducibility: Create protocol.json and seal outputs with SHA-256 hashes
roles.statistics: Design instrumented replay with transaction/session IDs, monotonic timestamps, lock acquisition timing, governance writer begin/commit timing; compute rejection rates and Wilson confidence intervals

safety_invariant: forbidden_commit_observed must be false in all historical observations and all replay perturbation trials
